# acecloud_router (Resource)

Manages an Ace Cloud Router.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "acecloud_router" "main" {
  name                        = "production-router"
  admin_state_up              = true
  external_gateway_network_id = var.external_network_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the router. Must be 1-100 characters, alphanumeric with hyphens.

### Optional

- `admin_state_up` (Boolean) Administrative state of the router. Defaults to true.
- `description` (String) Human-readable description of the router.
- `external_gateway_network_id` (String) UUID of the external network for the router's gateway.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the router was created.
- `id` (String) Unique identifier of the router.
- `status` (String) Current status of the router (e.g. ACTIVE, BUILD).
- `updated_at` (String) Timestamp when the router was last updated.
